page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.medium is a compute-optimized instance provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base clock frequency of 2.5 GHz. The server offers a dedicated CPU allocation consisting of 1 physical core configured with hyper-threading to deliver 2 virtual CPUs. System memory totals 4.0 GB, providing a ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The hardware profile includes instruction set support for AVX, AVX-512 Foundation, AES, BMI2, and FMA. This instance type does not include local NVMe storage or discrete GPU accelerators.

Performance evaluation across benchmark suites places the instance in lower relative performance tiers compared to broader cloud server benchmarks. The single-core stress-ng benchmark recorded a score of 1097.68, while the multi-core stress-ng score registered at 1455.38. Geekbench scores reflect similar limits, with a single-core result of 913.0 and a multi-core result of 1064.0. Uncached memory read bandwidth measures 10.27 GB/sec, with write bandwidth at 9.34 GB/sec. Redis SET operation throughput reaches 1.42 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput measures 1.25 GB/sec.

Due to its modest single-core throughput and constrained memory capacity, the ecs.sn1.medium offers low resource overhead suited for entry-level workloads rather than memory-intensive or heavy computational tasks. The absence of bundled local storage requires attached remote block storage for persistent data. The instance is suited for lightweight web serving, low-traffic background microservices, basic utility tasks, and small-scale development or testing environments.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.medium is an entry-level compute instance powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features a dedicated CPU allocation with 1 physical core and 2 vCPUs paired with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio. It lacks bundled local storage and GPU hardware. Synthetic benchmarks place the instance in lower performance brackets, with a single-core stress-ng score of 1097.68, a multi-core score of 1455.38, and a Passmark CPU score of 1824.84. Uncached memory throughput reaches 10.27 GB/sec for reads and 9.34 GB/sec for writes. The server executes 1.42 million Redis SET operations per second and achieves 1.25 GB/sec in static web serving. The ecs.sn1.medium is best suited for low-traffic web serving, basic background microservices, and non-critical development and testing environments.
